reviews.author: Deborah Y
reviews.title: Amazing service. Above and beyond!
reviews.text: The Tavern at the Phoenician hotel is a really comfortable sports bar with a good selection of really tasty dishes. There’s something to appeal to everyone but I can personally recommend the salmon burger and the fish and chips. However, the thing that really makes this restaurant stand out from your average sports bar is the lovely staff who go out of their way to make everyone feel so welcome and valued. Special shout-out to Jasmine my waitress , who recognised me every time I came in and was super patient  with my menu tweaks and super knowledgeable with her recommendations.  I also want to mention Ashley the manager, who came over especially to help me choose a single glass of red wine. Her knowledge of wines  was awesome and she was so patient and really listens to what I was looking for and considering I was dining on my own, both Ashley and Jasmine went out of their way to make my dining experience at the tavern a really memorable experience. Amazing 5star service- I wish everywhere was like this!

reviews.author: Katey
reviews.title: Do the craft beer tasting!
reviews.text: We did the craft beer tasting with Matt while we were staying at the resort and had such a good time!!  He was so knowledgeable about the craft beer scene in AZ and picked some great beers I would have never given a try and actually liked!  Highly recommend to do the tasting with Matt!

reviews.author: Kirstin
reviews.title: Mid hot summerTavern Bar
reviews.text: Had wonderful wines and cocktails at the bar with impeccable service from Marvis. Highly recommend this summertime oasis.

reviews.author: Ed T
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: The Tavern is clean with modern and tasteful decor. We were greeted right away and decided to sit at the bar. The bar was clean, including the chairs. There's a good amount of beers and food on the menu. Our bartender was Marvis, who was very attentive and helpful. He was knowledgeable about their beer selection and gave good recommendations.

reviews.author: patraveller2007
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The tavern has great burgers sandwiches and drinks.  The Cowboy was outstanding: large bison burger with fixings and fries.  Service was friendly and efficient.  Highly recommended.

reviews.author: alissa
reviews.title: Our Favorite Dining Spot At The Phoenician
reviews.text:
During our 5 day stay at The Phoenician Resort, we found ourselves at the Tavern 3 times. You cannot beat the daily happy hour (we loved the fresh margaritas and moscow mules) and large portions of food. We enjoyed the HUGE nachos, cowboy burger, burrata mozzarella salad, and the sliders. 

The service was always great with a special shout-out to Erin and Alejandro. They were so very kind and accommodating. Lily was also great! 

We made a reservation for dinner once and the other 2 times, we walked in without a reservation. On the last day (Sunday lunch), we did have a 30 minute wait but enjoyed sitting downstairs on the golf course while we waited.

Overall, great food and great service!

reviews.author: Mary B
reviews.title: Brian Our Bartender and Our Server Joshua :)
reviews.text: We waited at our table for 25 mins with no server until we called over one of the workers Joshua, We told him we been waiting here for almost a half an hour with no service and without hesitation he apologized for that and pulled out a note pad and took our drink order first. We asked him if he was our server but he said no he wasn't but he didn't mind taking care of us for this moment. Not only did he give us full attention in a busy restaurant but he was able to take care of us and multiple guest. Joshua also describe each entree we was thinking about ordering and recommended the bartender Brian who was across from us. If it wasn't for Joshua we would of left so thank you for him. We will 110% be coming back hopefully we see you there Joshua and Brian:)

reviews.author: N1335FBjoyceh
reviews.title: Keith was exceptional
reviews.text: We had been here several years ago and remembered a menu item they no longer offered. We casually mentioned it to the bartender, Keith. The next day we visited this tavern again. Keith remembered us and said he talked with the chef. The chef would give a go at the item if we wanted to try it. It was delicious.

reviews.author: kathyhK9551WZ
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: William was our server on Christmas Day. He was not under the tree but he was a true gift to our meal. Attentive, funny, professional and a joy to have a conversation with during the meal. The restaurant was busy but he made us feel we were the only customers. Bravo to the entire staff.

reviews.author: RedSeal2021
reviews.title: Wow talk about a Girl Lily
reviews.text:
Wow talk about a Girl Lily my server is awesome! Native to Arizona and one smile that makes her mask disappear! It’s all in the eyes! She knowledgeable about the Tavern food and beverage and about her city! Don’t worry ladies and gentlemen Lilly is going to lead in this world like a star! Management pay attention untapped potential here promotion nothing says customer service like Lily! 
Rick

reviews.author: Shreder
reviews.title: 10 Days in Phoenix
reviews.text: We ate there twice after finishing of golf.  I had one of the best burgers every... you must try one! The hot chocolate cookie in a skillet with ice cream... is to die for!!  For casual dining with is a great place!! Enjoy!!!

reviews.author: Jessica S
reviews.title: Amazing food in a low key setting
reviews.text: Food was delicious ! Burger and Nashville chicken bites were a must. Very nice low key dinner at a great price!

reviews.author: Julie S
reviews.title: A gem with amazing food that beats best steakhouses!
reviews.text: Just go! This restaurant is outstanding. Best food on our trip by far and great, friendly service. Outdoor balcony option or indoor dining. Muzak a little loud but positives and fabulous food outweigh. Lamb chop appetizer has 5 rib chops cooked perfectly with yummy lemony curry mayo and outstanding jalapeño relish. Can serve as a main course. Butter cake is warm and heavenly.

reviews.author: MTVandend
reviews.title: Best meal of our stay at The Phoenician
reviews.text: We were a group of 7 people, and they accommodated us right away, and were super welcoming (despite the fact that we had tweens with us, and it's a tavern). The food was really good for "pub" food, and the atmosphere was friendly and lively.  We also dined at both J & G steakhouse and Mowry & Cotton which are on property and both decidedly "fancier".  In both other cases, we were disappointed. You wouldn't expect the pub/tavern to have been our best meal, but it was!

reviews.author: Scott A
reviews.title: A great little sports bar
reviews.text: The newly refurbished restaurant looks great, and it’s pretty much the same comfortable menu. Great burgers and the fries are outstanding.

reviews.author: Taylor B
reviews.title: Once you unpack at the Phoenician Hotel, it's hard to break away
reviews.text: As you should expect of a luxury resort, the Phoenician Hotel in Scottsdale, Arizona, has a lot to offer. So once you've unpacked, you find it difficult to break away. Like breakfast at Mowry and Cotton, lunch at the Phoenician Tavern and dinner at J & G Steakhouse. The new tavern, which opened in 2018, offers opportunities to enjoy some pub grab after a round of golf or sample some local craft beers while sitting in a booth and watching the game of the day on TV or snacking on this and that while sitting on the indoor/outdoor bar patio with views of the lush, green golf course. Open at 11 a.m. daily, the tavern advertises the longest Happy Hour in town. My wife and I stopped by for a quick lunch before another round of sight-seeing. We snacked on a dozen chicken wings with BBQ sauce, a bowl of tomato bisque, a plate of fish and chips with ale battered cod, tartar sauce and fries, a Patty Melt sandwich with prime beef, Swiss cheese, 1,000 Island dressing and braised onions on griddled marble rye bread and two large slices of hot apple pie with vanilla ice cream. Pub grub? Whatever you choose to label it, it really hits the spot.

reviews.author: Timbo23
reviews.title: Georgia was the perfect reflection of attentive and accomodating.
reviews.text: Georgia was the perfect reflection of attentive and accomodating.  The Smokehouse Burger will tantilize your tastebuds.Tip: When choosing your sides, they allow you to chose two, but you call it "HALF" of each, so you can enjoy more than one of the four options.

reviews.author: edwardmiller1
reviews.title: Visit
reviews.text: Loved the new remodel. Fun and service were excellent. We return often.great views at the outdoor patio.

reviews.author: Ron B
reviews.title: Family birthday celebration - from Saskatoon
reviews.text: Excellent food, staff and atmosphere. We were all very impressed. Would highly recommend and will certainly revisit our next trip out.

reviews.author: Amanda042003
reviews.title: Duelling Pianos
reviews.text: My husband and I visit Scottsdale every Summer from Wales in the Uk, this was the first time we had visited the Phoenician, I had booked it as a surprise for my husband for Father’s Day. I had seen the duelling pianos advertised and thought he would enjoy it. All I can say is fab! The music, service, food and atmosphere were all amazing, we had a fantastic evening and will definitely go back when we return next year for our annual vacation.

reviews.author: Compass54178411331
reviews.title: Happy Hour at The Phoenician Tavern
reviews.text: Great Menu!  Fabulous setting!  Staff very friendly.  We were a group of Seniors & enjoyed our time there immensely.

reviews.author: Yovahnna Aguilar
reviews.title: Great place for a family dinner.
reviews.text: I dined at The Tavern with 4 kids and another adult. The service was fantastic,friendly and propmt. Don't leave with out having the carrot cake!

reviews.author: LVMaui
reviews.title: WoW Great food and staff
reviews.text:
We were there 3 nights and went here every night. We NEVER do that. The Buffalo Burgers was so awesome that we could not help ourselves. The parmesan & garlic French fries were off the hook, the TATER tots – which I haven’t had in 40 years -  were great and the sweet potato fries with maple/Thai/chili dip were crazy. They split the burger for us, as we are East Coast and not that hungry @ 7/8 pm, and still gave us 2 sides each night. 

The staff were outstanding and very professional.  Alicia and Cora were so attentive and we had great conversations each night. Sorry we missed the dueling pianos but we had an early flight. A surprise when the chef came out and brought me a piece of cake for my birthday. We brought it back to our room and devoured it, sooooooo good! 

When we return we will go there again, every night! Such a pleasure to have great food and great people waiting on you! 

You have to go AT LEAST one time!!!

reviews.author: A. Vinnie V
reviews.title: Wonderful Lunch...
reviews.text: Was on a trip to Scottsdale and went to lunch with a group of friends to The Phoenician Tavern. It was a lovely restaurant overlooking the beautiful resort and golf course. We all enjoyed our lunch very much. A wonderful place to lunch at or before or after a round of golf.

reviews.author: PKPOWELL
reviews.title: Lunch before golf
reviews.text: This looks like a new addition to the Phoenician food service. The terrace overlooks the course and had healthy food choices, a good drink selection and excellent service.

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Great Casual Restaurant
reviews.text: Nice informal restaurant on the grounds of  the Phoenician Resort.  Great service and food..  The manager Rosa went out of her way to make our sure our dinner on opening night was enjoyable.

reviews.author: tprmajusa
reviews.title: Dinner and drinks
reviews.text: We had dinner and drinks with friends that were staying on the property.  The staff was excellent and very friendly.  We had prime rib and baked potato.  The prime rib had great flavor and the seared edges was mouth watering.  We will be back!

reviews.author: Naders1977
reviews.title: Evening View is Spectacular.
reviews.text: After checking in to our Casita, we walked across the street to get a bite to eat.  We were seated outdoors overlooking the golf course and a gorgeous view.  The meal was fantastic.  We had crab tots with duck fat dipping sauce, the patty melt and salad was amazing.  We also Had the pork belly sandwich and seasoned tots.  The drinks were well mixed and super tasty.  Worth every penny.

reviews.author: Tal_Hameed
reviews.title: Good service but far from the hotel
reviews.text: There's good service here but it's a bit far from the hotel. They do have a golf cart travel service but it's still a bit too much to walk. Good service at the restaurant though with good food.

reviews.author: restarter
reviews.title: Wine cellar a mess
reviews.text:
Service in the lounge was very good and had a great time the few nights we stayed Christmas week. Food excellent. 
We like wine. Wine list is like a thousand bottle book, so that’s great. Especially the fact there’s an extensive half bottle list of very good wines. Means you get to taste some great stuff and not commit to a whole bottle at whole bottle price! Makes a difference when it’s $200-500 a bottle. 
So we ordered a Chassagne-Montrachet. Server poured to taste - it was orange! I’ve never had a bottle in such bad shape. Completely corked. Ordered another Chassagne-Montrachet different chateaux. Orange again! Nasty. Server didn’t know what to do. A manager came over and confirmed both bottles bad. Apparently there’s not a sommelier there, so we were on our own. I decided for something simpler so just ordered a Gruener Ventliner. Orange again!!! 
We gave up and just got a couple glasses of Sonoma Cutrer from the bar. 
Never seen anything like it in my 40 some years of ordering wine. Also no Somme in a five star joint with thousands of bottles in the cellar? 
Two other strange points. Examining the bottles, the labels were moldy. And these weren’t 75 year old bottles 10-15 year max. Examining the list further it seems the vintages essentially stop at around 2008. Like no wine has ever been ordered since. Something really weird going on there…
Too bad

reviews.author: BridgewaterFamily of 4
reviews.title: Post-golf lunch
reviews.text: We had lunch here after golf. Staff is very nice and food was good. We had the choice of indoor or outdoor dining which was nice.

reviews.author: Kathryn E
reviews.title: Upscale barfood!
reviews.text: My husband and I had lunch one day while we were staying at the Phoenician. It has beautiful views of the golf course and a relaxed atmosphere. I had the patty melt, had wanted the fish and chips but they were out. The patty melt had a large burger, minimal onions and a sauce similar to whats on a reuben as well as cheese. Not greasy just fixed a little different. My husband had the Tri tip steak sandwiche. He loved it the meat was juicy and tender, he ate it all. We both had fries, you get a large portion but they were not hot. Great selection of wine!

reviews.author: Martin S
reviews.title: Great Bar, Outside Balcony, Food and Service!
reviews.text:
It was our first meal on our stay at the Phoenician and we enjoyed it very much!
The Balcony was  a perfect location - excellent views in the distance and a steady stream of golfers coming in after completing their round.
We had a great meal of grilled salmon and a patty melt.  Not one crumb was left on our plates - it was so good I ate it before thinking about the photograph 🤪.
Bar was excellent and fully stocked with lots of options.  
Service was excellent!

reviews.author: The_Travel_Family
reviews.title: Great for Breakfast
reviews.text:
We ate here for three mornings for breakfast whilst staying at the Phoenician resort, breakfast, service was fantastic, food came quickly and prepared to a great standard. Currently elite Bonvoy members get $37.95 taken off the check if staying at the hotel.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: TennisgalGreenBay_WI
reviews.title: Very Casual and scenic
reviews.text: Very Casual restaurant with outdoor dining.  Got a wonderful table overlooking the golf course.  My Quilt Cab wine was a bit pricey at $18, but it was really good.  I thought our server, Georgia did a great job steering me to it.   I loved my cod fish and chips....the fries were tasty, too.  My husband didn't like his shrimp and pasta dish...he said it didn't have much taste and had a very watery consistency.  I thought it should have been thicker, as well. We asked for some Parmesan to thicken it up, but that didn't really help the flavor.   My girlfriend had the shrimp and agreed.  The bread for the table was good.   Our server was very attentive and brought anything we asked, so I would love to have her again.

reviews.author: Dan F
reviews.title: Nice Place for Burgers
reviews.text: This place just recently reopened and is much better than it was before.  The calamari starter was enjoyable and the bison burger was cooked perfectly.  Wine list is awful and service good.

reviews.author: Debra B
reviews.title: Elegant building
reviews.text: We went to the grand opening and it was grand.  We sat at a table that afforded us a nice view.  Things seemed a bit discombobulated by not bad.  Food was good (not great) but they may be experiencing some growing pains.  The flowers were gorgeous!

reviews.author: Michael F
reviews.title: Burgers after golf
reviews.text:
Local bar to relax after a round of golf, great burgers & beverages, friendly staff & a good hang
 out place

reviews.author: Marian C
reviews.title: Could’ve been so much better
reviews.text:
A group of us met here on Saturday night for dinner and drinks and to listen to the “dueling pianos” around 730pm.  The staff were very accommodating, found us a table for 10 in a room that was fairly full. The menu offers a good variety and is good.  However when the “dueling pianos” commenced the sound was so loud we couldn’t understand the lyrics and obviously we couldn’t converse with our group.  We asked the staff if they could turn it down twice with no action.  By 9 pm 75% of the patrons had left, by 930 our group gave up also.  On our way out we mentioned that though we enjoyed the music and thought the entertainers were excellent but the sound was way too loud. 

His comment was “have a good evening”.

reviews.author: John B
reviews.title: Meh.  Disappointed
reviews.text: Our family of four adults  had dinner here.  After offering my 21 year old the kids menu, we had just OK food and waaaayy too red warm wine.  Like undrinkable.  Overall, the menu had promise but did not deliver.

reviews.author: TravelinJabbo
reviews.title: Average food
reviews.text: We were out for a walk around the Phonician grounds, and stopped here for lunch. The staff were friendly and accomodating, and food came quickly. I had the cashew chicken salad on a brioche roll with fries. It looked great, but the sandwich was dry, the cashews were soggy, and the fries were cold. My wife enjoyed her salad. The food here wasn't good enough for a repeat visit during our stay.

reviews.author: mollydog391
reviews.title: What a disappointment
reviews.text: Food was indifferent and service inattentive. My husband was served the most expensive vodka he’d ever ordered ($25!!).  This was our first time and we won’t be back.

reviews.author: loneladytraveler
reviews.title: Thanksgiving Buffet -- do not recommend
reviews.text: Went here for the Thanksgiving buffet. It was understaffed and too small for the number of reservations they accepted. The mac and chesse was cold, the stuffing was gummy, all received after you wait in a long line at a cramped ersatz buffet setup squeezed into a corner.  The potatoes, the beef, and the beef au jus were good. My spouse liked the turkey. It was also ridiclous that the restaurant imposed a mandatory 20% service charge -- on a buffet!  Where you serve yoursel!

reviews.author: Reagan W
reviews.title: I was Overcharged.
reviews.text: Tonight I came for 25$ meal deal until September 2nd. I order two cowboy burgers and two margaritas. The deal through September 2nd includes one drink. One burger and one side for 25$ each. When I revveived my check my total was $70.92. I asked the server why it was so much more and she said it can't be combined with happy hour. And I said I didn't order off of happy hour I ordered off of the 25$ meal. She refused to change the total and still charged me $70.92. Although the burger was excellent this is poor service and false advertising. The servers name was Arba. I overheard heard talking to another person and it sounds like she is one of the main servers at the bar. This is not okay!! it says “Enjoy Any Burger”

reviews.author: Jonathan
reviews.title: Unauthorized food & beverage charge
reviews.text: We already checked out of the hotel. We had too many issues. This is another. I receive a copy of my folio every morning from my Ambassador. I noticed a charge of several hundred dollars on the folio. We had room service that evening. I reported this to LP (Jose who is outstanding) & was told they would get back to me. Jose (along with (tavern manager) Julie found out it was an unauthorized charge. An employee charged food & beverage to my suite. Julie did do the right thing & make this right; something other hotel employees should learn from. The unauthorized charge was very unfortunate. The follow up & resolution was outstanding. Please have your employees be more careful. I spent numerous hours Sunday looking into this.

reviews.author: Jackie W
reviews.title: Terrible Service for Large Group with advance reservations
reviews.text:
The is the second year in a row for our team stay-cation at the Phoenician.  Last year's group meal at the Tavern had extremely slow service but we though we would give it another chance this year.  Even though we had reservations well in advance (24 people), we had absolutely horrible service.  It took 1 1/2 hours to get everyone their first round of drinks.  Several did not get their food until others were begging at the front desk for their bill.  Overall a complete disaster AND....  everyone who ordered straight well drinks, I.e. gin & tonic, were served and charged for top shelf (i.e. Hendricks).  A double vodka Redbull cost $44!  

I don't know how the food was... we were all too upset with the service and the insane prices to compare notes on the food.

reviews.author: David Thielen
reviews.title: Overcooked beyond imagination
reviews.text:
While we were waiting for our room we went to the Tavern to get lunch. It’s a nice setting although annoying because they have the audio of a golf game playing over the speakers. The people working there were all nice and prompt.

The food sucked. I got the French Dip and I don’t think I’ve ever had roast beef that was more overcooked. To call it as bad as shoe leather does a disservice to shoe leather. My wife got the Cobb Salad and she said it was passable, barely.

On the plus side, the beer was good and came in chilled glasses.

reviews.author: Jessica N
reviews.title: Unorganized and not worth it
reviews.text: We waited about 15 minutes past when our reservation was then after getting sat had no one come to the table or greet and acknowledge us.  In the 30 minutes we waited two tables next to us were sat and had their orders taken.  We left with no acknowledgement by the staff after a 53 minute experience.  I would pass and just go down the road to In and Out Burger if you really need lunch.

reviews.author: Rose Garlasco
reviews.title: Happy Hour and Dinner
reviews.text: Would not recommend the resort’s restaurants. Went to the Tavern for happy hour. Limited menu. Paid $20 for a vodka!  Had dinner at J&G restaurant. Busgirl kept clearing our plates and food and we weren’t done. My steak came out 10 minutes later than everyone else’s at the table. They forgot it!  The General Manager was arrogant and non-apologetic. They did comp my dinner and give us dessert but the damage was already done. Very disappointing and do not recommend it. Too many other great restaurants in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: bowman4774
reviews.title: bad experience
reviews.text: We had a reservation for our anniversary.  They were having some kind of charity event.  We moved our seat several times because of the noise and people standing around.  Service was lousy and we eventually left without having dinner.

reviews.title: Meh.  Disappointed
reviews.text: Our family of four adults  had dinner here.  After offering my 21 year old the kids menu, we had just OK food and waaaayy too red warm wine.  Like undrinkable.  Overall, the menu had promise but did not deliver.

reviews.text: Excellent food, staff and atmosphere. We were all very impressed. Would highly recommend and will certainly revisit our next trip out.

reviews.title: Great place for a family dinner.
reviews.text: I dined at The Tavern with 4 kids and another adult. The service was fantastic,friendly and propmt. Don't leave with out having the carrot cake!

reviews.title: Brian Our Bartender and Our Server Joshua :)
reviews.text: We waited at our table for 25 mins with no server until we called over one of the workers Joshua, We told him we been waiting here for almost a half an hour with no service and without hesitation he apologized for that and pulled out a note pad and took our drink order first. We asked him if he was our server but he said no he wasn't but he didn't mind taking care of us for this moment. Not only did he give us full attention in a busy restaurant but he was able to take care of us and multiple guest. Joshua also describe each entree we was thinking about ordering and recommended the bartender Brian who was across from us. If it wasn't for Joshua we would of left so thank you for him. We will 110% be coming back hopefully we see you there Joshua and Brian:)

reviews.author: Jessica N
reviews.title: Unorganized and not worth it
reviews.text: We waited about 15 minutes past when our reservation was then after getting sat had no one come to the table or greet and acknowledge us.  In the 30 minutes we waited two tables next to us were sat and had their orders taken.  We left with no acknowledgement by the staff after a 53 minute experience.  I would pass and just go down the road to In and Out Burger if you really need lunch.

reviews.author: Shreder
reviews.title: 10 Days in Phoenix
reviews.text: We ate there twice after finishing of golf.  I had one of the best burgers every... you must try one! The hot chocolate cookie in a skillet with ice cream... is to die for!!  For casual dining with is a great place!! Enjoy!!!

reviews.author: Scott A
reviews.title: A great little sports bar
reviews.text: The newly refurbished restaurant looks great, and it’s pretty much the same comfortable menu. Great burgers and the fries are outstanding.

reviews.author: Rose Garlasco
reviews.title: Happy Hour and Dinner
reviews.text: Would not recommend the resort’s restaurants. Went to the Tavern for happy hour. Limited menu. Paid $20 for a vodka!  Had dinner at J&G restaurant. Busgirl kept clearing our plates and food and we weren’t done. My steak came out 10 minutes later than everyone else’s at the table. They forgot it!  The General Manager was arrogant and non-apologetic. They did comp my dinner and give us dessert but the damage was already done. Very disappointing and do not recommend it. Too many other great restaurants in Scottsdale.

reviews.author: bowman4774
reviews.title: bad experience
reviews.text: We had a reservation for our anniversary.  They were having some kind of charity event.  We moved our seat several times because of the noise and people standing around.  Service was lousy and we eventually left without having dinner.

reviews.author: edwardmiller1
reviews.title: Visit
reviews.text: Loved the new remodel. Fun and service were excellent. We return often.great views at the outdoor patio.

reviews.author: Amanda042003
reviews.title: Duelling Pianos
reviews.text: My husband and I visit Scottsdale every Summer from Wales in the Uk, this was the first time we had visited the Phoenician, I had booked it as a surprise for my husband for Father’s Day. I had seen the duelling pianos advertised and thought he would enjoy it. All I can say is fab! The music, service, food and atmosphere were all amazing, we had a fantastic evening and will definitely go back when we return next year for our annual vacation.

reviews.author: LVMaui
reviews.title: WoW Great food and staff
reviews.text:
We were there 3 nights and went here every night. We NEVER do that. The Buffalo Burgers was so awesome that we could not help ourselves. The parmesan & garlic French fries were off the hook, the TATER tots – which I haven’t had in 40 years -  were great and the sweet potato fries with maple/Thai/chili dip were crazy. They split the burger for us, as we are East Coast and not that hungry @ 7/8 pm, and still gave us 2 sides each night. 

The staff were outstanding and very professional.  Alicia and Cora were so attentive and we had great conversations each night. Sorry we missed the dueling pianos but we had an early flight. A surprise when the chef came out and brought me a piece of cake for my birthday. We brought it back to our room and devoured it, sooooooo good! 

When we return we will go there again, every night! Such a pleasure to have great food and great people waiting on you! 

You have to go AT LEAST one time!!!

reviews.author: Debra B
reviews.title: Elegant building
reviews.text: We went to the grand opening and it was grand.  We sat at a table that afforded us a nice view.  Things seemed a bit discombobulated by not bad.  Food was good (not great) but they may be experiencing some growing pains.  The flowers were gorgeous!

reviews.author: Michael F
reviews.title: Burgers after golf
reviews.text:
Local bar to relax after a round of golf, great burgers & beverages, friendly staff & a good hang
 out place

reviews.author: Mike B
reviews.title: Great Casual Restaurant
reviews.text: Nice informal restaurant on the grounds of  the Phoenician Resort.  Great service and food..  The manager Rosa went out of her way to make our sure our dinner on opening night was enjoyable.

reviews.author: tprmajusa
reviews.title: Dinner and drinks
reviews.text: We had dinner and drinks with friends that were staying on the property.  The staff was excellent and very friendly.  We had prime rib and baked potato.  The prime rib had great flavor and the seared edges was mouth watering.  We will be back!

reviews.author: Deborah Y
reviews.title: Amazing service. Above and beyond!
reviews.text: The Tavern at the Phoenician hotel is a really comfortable sports bar with a good selection of really tasty dishes. There’s something to appeal to everyone but I can personally recommend the salmon burger and the fish and chips. However, the thing that really makes this restaurant stand out from your average sports bar is the lovely staff who go out of their way to make everyone feel so welcome and valued. Special shout-out to Jasmine my waitress , who recognised me every time I came in and was super patient  with my menu tweaks and super knowledgeable with her recommendations.  I also want to mention Ashley the manager, who came over especially to help me choose a single glass of red wine. Her knowledge of wines  was awesome and she was so patient and really listens to what I was looking for and considering I was dining on my own, both Ashley and Jasmine went out of their way to make my dining experience at the tavern a really memorable experience. Amazing 5star service- I wish everywhere was like this!

reviews.author: Reagan W
reviews.title: I was Overcharged.
reviews.text: Tonight I came for 25$ meal deal until September 2nd. I order two cowboy burgers and two margaritas. The deal through September 2nd includes one drink. One burger and one side for 25$ each. When I revveived my check my total was $70.92. I asked the server why it was so much more and she said it can't be combined with happy hour. And I said I didn't order off of happy hour I ordered off of the 25$ meal. She refused to change the total and still charged me $70.92. Although the burger was excellent this is poor service and false advertising. The servers name was Arba. I overheard heard talking to another person and it sounds like she is one of the main servers at the bar. This is not okay!! it says “Enjoy Any Burger”

reviews.author: Julie S
reviews.title: A gem with amazing food that beats best steakhouses!
reviews.text: Just go! This restaurant is outstanding. Best food on our trip by far and great, friendly service. Outdoor balcony option or indoor dining. Muzak a little loud but positives and fabulous food outweigh. Lamb chop appetizer has 5 rib chops cooked perfectly with yummy lemony curry mayo and outstanding jalapeño relish. Can serve as a main course. Butter cake is warm and heavenly.

reviews.author: Naders1977
reviews.title: Evening View is Spectacular.
reviews.text: After checking in to our Casita, we walked across the street to get a bite to eat.  We were seated outdoors overlooking the golf course and a gorgeous view.  The meal was fantastic.  We had crab tots with duck fat dipping sauce, the patty melt and salad was amazing.  We also Had the pork belly sandwich and seasoned tots.  The drinks were well mixed and super tasty.  Worth every penny.

reviews.author: PKPOWELL
reviews.title: Lunch before golf
reviews.text: This looks like a new addition to the Phoenician food service. The terrace overlooks the course and had healthy food choices, a good drink selection and excellent service.

reviews.author: Marian C
reviews.title: Could’ve been so much better
reviews.text:
A group of us met here on Saturday night for dinner and drinks and to listen to the “dueling pianos” around 730pm.  The staff were very accommodating, found us a table for 10 in a room that was fairly full. The menu offers a good variety and is good.  However when the “dueling pianos” commenced the sound was so loud we couldn’t understand the lyrics and obviously we couldn’t converse with our group.  We asked the staff if they could turn it down twice with no action.  By 9 pm 75% of the patrons had left, by 930 our group gave up also.  On our way out we mentioned that though we enjoyed the music and thought the entertainers were excellent but the sound was way too loud. 

His comment was “have a good evening”.

reviews.author: Kirstin
reviews.title: Mid hot summerTavern Bar
reviews.text: Had wonderful wines and cocktails at the bar with impeccable service from Marvis. Highly recommend this summertime oasis.

reviews.author: Jessica S
reviews.title: Amazing food in a low key setting
reviews.text: Food was delicious ! Burger and Nashville chicken bites were a must. Very nice low key dinner at a great price!

reviews.author: Compass54178411331
reviews.title: Happy Hour at The Phoenician Tavern
reviews.text: Great Menu!  Fabulous setting!  Staff very friendly.  We were a group of Seniors & enjoyed our time there immensely.

reviews.author: A. Vinnie V
reviews.title: Wonderful Lunch...
reviews.text: Was on a trip to Scottsdale and went to lunch with a group of friends to The Phoenician Tavern. It was a lovely restaurant overlooking the beautiful resort and golf course. We all enjoyed our lunch very much. A wonderful place to lunch at or before or after a round of golf.

reviews.author: Dan F
reviews.title: Nice Place for Burgers
reviews.text: This place just recently reopened and is much better than it was before.  The calamari starter was enjoyable and the bison burger was cooked perfectly.  Wine list is awful and service good.

reviews.author: Katey
reviews.title: Do the craft beer tasting!
reviews.text: We did the craft beer tasting with Matt while we were staying at the resort and had such a good time!!  He was so knowledgeable about the craft beer scene in AZ and picked some great beers I would have never given a try and actually liked!  Highly recommend to do the tasting with Matt!

reviews.author: restarter
reviews.title: Wine cellar a mess
reviews.text:
Service in the lounge was very good and had a great time the few nights we stayed Christmas week. Food excellent. 
We like wine. Wine list is like a thousand bottle book, so that’s great. Especially the fact there’s an extensive half bottle list of very good wines. Means you get to taste some great stuff and not commit to a whole bottle at whole bottle price! Makes a difference when it’s $200-500 a bottle. 
So we ordered a Chassagne-Montrachet. Server poured to taste - it was orange! I’ve never had a bottle in such bad shape. Completely corked. Ordered another Chassagne-Montrachet different chateaux. Orange again! Nasty. Server didn’t know what to do. A manager came over and confirmed both bottles bad. Apparently there’s not a sommelier there, so we were on our own. I decided for something simpler so just ordered a Gruener Ventliner. Orange again!!! 
We gave up and just got a couple glasses of Sonoma Cutrer from the bar. 
Never seen anything like it in my 40 some years of ordering wine. Also no Somme in a five star joint with thousands of bottles in the cellar? 
Two other strange points. Examining the bottles, the labels were moldy. And these weren’t 75 year old bottles 10-15 year max. Examining the list further it seems the vintages essentially stop at around 2008. Like no wine has ever been ordered since. Something really weird going on there…
Too bad

reviews.author: MTVandend
reviews.title: Best meal of our stay at The Phoenician
reviews.text: We were a group of 7 people, and they accommodated us right away, and were super welcoming (despite the fact that we had tweens with us, and it's a tavern). The food was really good for "pub" food, and the atmosphere was friendly and lively.  We also dined at both J & G steakhouse and Mowry & Cotton which are on property and both decidedly "fancier".  In both other cases, we were disappointed. You wouldn't expect the pub/tavern to have been our best meal, but it was!

reviews.author: Martin S
reviews.title: Great Bar, Outside Balcony, Food and Service!
reviews.text:
It was our first meal on our stay at the Phoenician and we enjoyed it very much!
The Balcony was  a perfect location - excellent views in the distance and a steady stream of golfers coming in after completing their round.
We had a great meal of grilled salmon and a patty melt.  Not one crumb was left on our plates - it was so good I ate it before thinking about the photograph 🤪.
Bar was excellent and fully stocked with lots of options.  
Service was excellent!

I thought our server, Georgia did a great job steering me to it.   I loved my cod fish and chips....the fries were tasty, too.  My husband didn't like his shrimp and pasta dish...he said it didn't have much taste and had a very watery consistency.  I thought it should have been thicker, as well. We asked for some Parmesan to thicken it up, but that didn't really help the flavor.   My girlfriend had the shrimp and agreed.  The bread for the table was good.   Our server was very attentive and brought anything we asked, so I would love to have her again.

reviews.title: Overcooked beyond imagination

While we were waiting for our room we went to the Tavern to get lunch. It’s a nice setting although annoying because they have the audio of a golf game playing over the speakers. The people working there were all nice and prompt.

The food sucked. I got the French Dip and I don’t think I’ve ever had roast beef that was more overcooked. To call it as bad as shoe leather does a disservice to shoe leather. My wife got the Cobb Salad and she said it was passable, barely.

On the plus side, the beer was good and came in chilled glasses.

reviews.title: Our Favorite Dining Spot At The Phoenician
reviews.text:
During our 5 day stay at The Phoenician Resort, we found ourselves at the Tavern 3 times. You cannot beat the daily happy hour (we loved the fresh margaritas and moscow mules) and large portions of food. We enjoyed the HUGE nachos, cowboy burger, burrata mozzarella salad, and the sliders. 

The service was always great with a special shout-out to Erin and Alejandro. They were so very kind and accommodating. Lily was also great! 

We made a reservation for dinner once and the other 2 times, we walked in without a reservation. On the last day (Sunday lunch), we did have a 30 minute wait but enjoyed sitting downstairs on the golf course while we waited.

Overall, great food and great service!

reviews.author: Kathryn E
reviews.title: Upscale barfood!
reviews.text: My husband and I had lunch one day while we were staying at the Phoenician. It has beautiful views of the golf course and a relaxed atmosphere. I had the patty melt, had wanted the fish and chips but they were out. The patty melt had a large burger, minimal onions and a sauce similar to whats on a reuben as well as cheese. Not greasy just fixed a little different. My husband had the Tri tip steak sandwiche. He loved it the meat was juicy and tender, he ate it all. We both had fries, you get a large portion but they were not hot. Great selection of wine!

There's a good amount of beers and food on the menu. Our bartender was Marvis, who was very attentive and helpful. He was knowledgeable about their beer selection and gave good recommendations.

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: The tavern has great burgers sandwiches and drinks.  The Cowboy was outstanding: large bison burger with fixings and fries.  Service was friendly and efficient.  Highly recommended.

reviews.text: Our family of four adults  had dinner here.  After offering my 21 year old the kids menu, we had just OK food and waaaayy too red warm wine.  Like undrinkable.  Overall, the menu had promise but did not deliver.

reviews.title: Great place for a family dinner.
reviews.text: I dined at The Tavern with 4 kids and another adult. The service was fantastic,friendly and propmt. Don't leave with out having the carrot cake!

reviews.title: Terrible Service for Large Group with advance reservations
reviews.text:
The is the second year in a row for our team stay-cation at the Phoenician.  Last year's group meal at the Tavern had extremely slow service but we though we would give it another chance this year.  Even though we had reservations well in advance (24 people), we had absolutely horrible service.  It took 1 1/2 hours to get everyone their first round of drinks.  Several did not get their food until others were begging at the front desk for their bill.  Overall a complete disaster AND....  everyone who ordered straight well drinks, I.e. gin & tonic, were served and charged for top shelf (i.e. Hendricks).  A double vodka Redbull cost $44!  

I don't know how the food was... we were all too upset with the service and the insane prices to compare notes on the food.

reviews.title: Great for Breakfast
reviews.text:
We ate here for three mornings for breakfast whilst staying at the Phoenician resort, breakfast, service was fantastic, food came quickly and prepared to a great standard. Currently elite Bonvoy members get $37.95 taken off the check if staying at the hotel.

Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Jonathan
reviews.title: Unauthorized food & beverage charge
reviews.text: We already checked out of the hotel. We had too many issues. This is another. I receive a copy of my folio every morning from my Ambassador. I noticed a charge of several hundred dollars on the folio. We had room service that evening. I reported this to LP (Jose who is outstanding) & was told they would get back to me. Jose (along with (tavern manager) Julie found out it was an unauthorized charge. An employee charged food & beverage to my suite. Julie did do the right thing & make this right; something other hotel employees should learn from. The unauthorized charge was very unfortunate. The follow up & resolution was outstanding. Please have your employees be more careful. I spent numerous hours Sunday looking into this.

reviews.author: loneladytraveler
reviews.title: Thanksgiving Buffet -- do not recommend
reviews.text: Went here for the Thanksgiving buffet. It was understaffed and too small for the number of reservations they accepted. The mac and chesse was cold, the stuffing was gummy, all received after you wait in a long line at a cramped ersatz buffet setup squeezed into a corner.  The potatoes, the beef, and the beef au jus were good. My spouse liked the turkey. It was also ridiclous that the restaurant imposed a mandatory 20% service charge -- on a buffet!  Where you serve yoursel!

reviews.author: Scott A
reviews.title: A great little sports bar
reviews.text: The newly refurbished restaurant looks great, and it’s pretty much the same comfortable menu. Great burgers and the fries are outstanding.

reviews.author: Taylor B
reviews.title: Once you unpack at the Phoenician Hotel, it's hard to break away
reviews.text: As you should expect of a luxury resort, the Phoenician Hotel in Scottsdale, Arizona, has a lot to offer. So once you've unpacked, you find it difficult to break away. Like breakfast at Mowry and Cotton, lunch at the Phoenician Tavern and dinner at J & G Steakhouse. The new tavern, which opened in 2018, offers opportunities to enjoy some pub grab after a round of golf or sample some local craft beers while sitting in a booth and watching the game of the day on TV or snacking on this and that while sitting on the indoor/outdoor bar patio with views of the lush, green golf course. Open at 11 a.m. daily, the tavern advertises the longest Happy Hour in town. My wife and I stopped by for a quick lunch before another round of sight-seeing. We snacked on a dozen chicken wings with BBQ sauce, a bowl of tomato bisque, a plate of fish and chips with ale battered cod, tartar sauce and fries, a Patty Melt sandwich with prime beef, Swiss cheese, 1,000 Island dressing and braised onions on griddled marble rye bread and two large slices of hot apple pie with vanilla ice cream. Pub grub? Whatever you choose to label it, it really hits the spot.

reviews.author: kathyhK9551WZ
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: William was our server on Christmas Day. He was not under the tree but he was a true gift to our meal. Attentive, funny, professional and a joy to have a conversation with during the meal. The restaurant was busy but he made us feel we were the only customers. Bravo to the entire staff.

reviews.author: Jessica N
reviews.title: Unorganized and not worth it
reviews.text: We waited about 15 minutes past when our reservation was then after getting sat had no one come to the table or greet and acknowledge us.  In the 30 minutes we waited two tables next to us were sat and had their orders taken.  We left with no acknowledgement by the staff after a 53 minute experience.  I would pass and just go down the road to In and Out Burger if you really need lunch.
